scope: Post-clear native handback versus treatment and fleeing; CQB flow source comparison
finding: GroupBrainStep could issue doFollow from an exact post-clear STOP while ACE treatment was queued or native fleeing active. CombatEffective and ActorMoveReserved do not reject either state. BuildingOperationStep and shutdown already guard both.
implementation: Add treatment/flight refusal to existing post-clear doFollow admission.
Retain only unchanged exact STOP proof during temporary treatment/flight. New native commands or changed pose do not inherit stale recall.
No new worker, scan, destination, recovery budget or deadline. Existing generation/locality/external owner checks remain.

source_comparison.LAMBS: doAssaultCQB shares per-side building positions, requests movement with small random offset plus FORMATION PLANNED destination, schedules repeat after seven seconds, and can retire the first point through RND(0.95) or proximity. No-buildings path follows leader. tacticsCQB supplies shared building list and temporarily disables attack.
source_comparison.CBE: Eligible squad admission capped at eight concurrent workers/topology; remaining actors can become exit-observation security. Physical visit collector and pair participation are distinct from point assignment. Successful finish issues one-shot positional holds, with native order handback on existing group brain. Natural successful clears can continue a plain unchanged MOVE route.
source_comparison.selected_intent: Maintain continuous squad participation and bounded tactical ownership, with useful exterior security and post-clear continuation.
source_comparison.deliberate_departures: Do not copy probabilistic point retirement as physical coverage, unowned delayed callbacks, blanket follow-to-interior-leader or competing formation destination writes. Source source-shape comparison does not prove CBE flow is equal or superior.
source_comparison.remaining: Coherent entry, exterior isolation, repeat clearing, inaccessible modded nodes, casualty replacement and post-clear travel require physical validation; not resolved by this narrow handback fix.
